notes:
Summary: Large payments processor evaluating Redwood Private VPC to run customer-facing assistants and a reranking pipeline that augments transaction metadata. Primary constraints: strict PCI scoping, EU data residency for EMEA customers, and KMS/HSM integration to ensure encryption keys never leave the customer's control. They require per-request audit logs forwarded to Splunk and immutable retention for 7 years for a subset of event types.

Direct quote: "If there's any chance model inputs can include cardholder data, Legal will require full PCI scoping and a compensating control. We prefer tokenization at the proxy and no raw PANs reaching the model."  Head of Security.

Compliance asks: Provide a clear SOC 2 mapping that shows which controls are satisfied by Redwood Private in-customer VPC vs responsibilities retained by the customer; ISO 27001 evidence list for deployment artifacts (SLA, network diagrams, config baselines); HIPAA/BAA stub requested only if support transcripts include PHI (rare but flagged by Ops). For PCI they want guidance on scope reduction: redaction at the edge, deterministic token mapping, and post-call audit trails.

KMS/crypto: Customer insists on AWS KMS (HSM) integration with envelope encryption; needs a trust-boundary diagram and guidance on key rotation and disaster recovery. They asked about possible use of customer HSM appliance on-prem for escrow.

Network/security: No outbound egress to public internet from model nodes; allowlist for customer endpoints only; VPC endpoints for logging sinks. EKS/AWS deployment preferred.

POC scope: 6-week Private VPC POC: deploy model inside Venari VPC, integrate KMS with envelope encryption, stream audit logs to Splunk, run synthetic transaction prompts (tokenized), validate latency SLO p95 < 220ms for chat path and 1500 TPS for bulk reranking batch, verify retention and replayability of logs. Provide compliance matrix (SOC2/ISO/HIPAA/PCI) and a draft BAA.

Action items: Redwood to deliver compliance matrix + KMS trust diagram by 2026-03-12; SE to provide PCI scoping note and redaction pattern examples (proxy configs, regex rules, tokenization flow).
